summary: Analog partition layout: the committed pad-ring assembly stream, generated by layout/scripts/gen_pad_ring_assembly.py from layout/gds/cml_driver_core.gds (itself generated by gen_cml_driver_core.py). Regeneration is NOT claimed byte-for-byte: a re-run of the generator under klayout 0.30 (klt venv) produced a different file hash because the GDS header carries a write timestamp (two consecutive re-runs differ from each other), but a per-layer XOR of the re-run against this committed stream was empty (0 area on every layer). Provenance is documented, not byte-reproduced.
